description: Coverage statistics for the regmonitoring.com regulatory corpus: how many updates are indexed, the date range they span, how many regulators and jurisdictions are represented, and how many records carry AI analysis, a deadline, a penalty amount or an urgency rating. Call this before making claims about what the corpus does or does not contain — most records have no penalty amount, so an empty enforcement result usually means the data is absent rather than that no enforcement occurred.
name: regmonitoring_get_stats
title: Get coverage statistics
